coverage.evidence: New voice trigger dialog defaults (word empty, Start counting at 0, Seconds between counts 5, No sticker) at dashboard/src/views/dashboard/voice-triggers/components/NewVoiceTriggerDialog.vue:33-46, empty-word message at :49-53, and create without isEnabled starts enabled at server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Commands/Dtos/VoiceTriggerDtos.cs:37. Popout listener opens a popup window at components/VoiceListenerHeader.vue:47-51, and the listener page title, Listening status, microphone and en-US recognition are at server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/VoiceListenerPageController.cs:69,94,110,206-209. Heard so far in the editor is at components/VoiceTriggerEditor.vue:54-62, and it updates live through dashboard/src/realtime/configDomains.ts:77 and VoiceTriggerService.cs:278.

The listener must stay open in real Chrome and not in OBS (VoiceListenerPageController.cs:20-27,95,102). It keeps the newest 20 phrases first (:126-142) and restarts on onend, or shows Stopped when blocked (:224-230). A repeat within the cooldown is not counted and the listener shows (no trigger word) (VoiceTriggerService.cs:266-273, VoiceListenerPageController.cs:145-153). Only one enabled trigger is matched per phrase, case-insensitive substring (VoiceTriggerService.cs:256-262). Closing the listener stops counting (VoiceListenerPageController.cs:102). The routes are VoiceTriggersController.cs:31 and VoiceTriggerReportController.cs:31,49.

Opening the listener page calls start(), which runs SpeechRecognition (VoiceListenerPageController.cs:203-236). Every final chunk is reported (:212-217). The transcript segment is stored only when a stream row has EndedAt null (VoiceTriggerService.cs:236-254). Matching and counting have no live check (:256-278), and Voice.TranscriptHeard is published either way (:222-230), journaled by JournalingEventBusDecorator.cs:57-63, with the public name at AutomationEventDescriptors.cs:132. A phrase longer than 200 characters is refused with 400 before ReportAsync runs (VoiceTriggerDtos.cs:67-69, VoiceTriggerReportController.cs:30).

voicetriggers:read defaults to Mod with a Vip floor, and voicetriggers:write is Mod (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:190-191). Levels are Vip 4, Mod 10, LeadModerator 20, Editor 30, Broadcaster 40 (:50-54). Lowering an action needs roles:manage (Broadcaster), at ActionPermissionsController.cs:53 and ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:213. A reader without write sees no New button, editor or row actions (VoiceTriggersView.vue:49,92,143,154) but sees Popout listener and Copy listener link (:91,113-118), because listener-link needs only read (VoiceTriggersController.cs:50-51). Bot manager gets voicetriggers:* (BotManagerBundle.cs:32). The link carries the channel OverlayToken (VoiceTriggersController.cs:55-60, VoiceTriggerService.cs:321-324), which authenticates reports (VoiceTriggerReportController.cs:56-65).

New triggers default IsEnabled true (VoiceTriggerDtos.cs:37), and the dialog does not send it (NewVoiceTriggerDialog.vue:58-64). UpdateAsync never touches CurrentCount or StartingCount, and the update request has no StartingCount (VoiceTriggerService.cs:138-179, VoiceTriggerDtos.cs:50-62); the page states this through 'You can set it only now' and the Off trigger keeping its count. The Enabled switch saves at once (VoiceTriggerEditor.vue:82-84,102-108). Delete removes the row (VoiceTriggerService.cs:203-204), the confirm text says the count is lost (i18n/en.json editor.confirmTitle/confirmBody/confirmAction), and the sticker asset is untouched (VoiceTriggersController.cs:101-103).

reader_answers.evidence: The Popout listener and microphone flow matches VoiceListenerHeader.vue:47-51 and VoiceListenerPageController.cs:94,206-209. The dialog defaults 0, 5 and No sticker match NewVoiceTriggerDialog.vue:33-46. Create voice trigger is the dialog action (i18n/en.json dialog.create), and Heard so far is in VoiceTriggerEditor.vue:54.

The roles match ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:50-54,190-191 and BotManagerBundle.cs:32. A VIP can only view because write is not lowerable and the UI hides write controls (VoiceTriggersView.vue:49,92,154). The Chrome-not-OBS requirement is at VoiceListenerPageController.cs:20-27,95, and the microphone grant is at :59.

The listener verdict 'Matched "word" (count N)' is at VoiceListenerPageController.cs:145-150, Heard so far at VoiceTriggerEditor.vue:54, and 'Heard N times' at i18n/en.json list.heard. The header shows only a past lastFiredAt (VoiceListenerHeader.vue:27-44,58).

The window that must stay open is the Voice Listener popup or the pasted listener link in Chrome (VoiceListenerHeader.vue:49, VoiceTriggersController.cs:59-60, VoiceListenerPageController.cs:94). OBS CEF has no SpeechRecognition (:20-24), and closing the tab stops counting until it is reopened (:102).
